values.note: First-come, first-served only, no reservations: claim a site in person and pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check or money order) or by the Recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay. Sites must be occupied the first night paid. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; up to eight people per site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/angel-shavano-campground ('This campground is first come, first served. No reservations are accepted.'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay is permitted'; 'A self-service fee tube is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165115 ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only ... Scan and Pay'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Open mid-May to mid-September, weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/angel-shavano-campground ('This campground is open from mid-May to mid-September, dependent on weather.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $25 a site per night, two vehicles or one RV (with tow vehicle) included; $10 for a third vehicle; $10 day use.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/angel-shavano-campground ('$25.00 for overnight use as of 2025 ... Two vehicles or one recreational vehicle (RV) per site is included in the camping fee. $10 for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165115/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19: 25), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water at a hand pump; firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/angel-shavano-campground ('Vault Toilet'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.') + rec.gov notices ('Firewood is available for sale at Host site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior and Access pass holders get 50% off the site they occupy (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/angel-shavano-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Wooded (aspen and spruce) sites along the North Fork of the South Arkansas River at ~9,200 ft, 3 miles up CR 240 from US-50 at Maysville; the Colorado Trail's Angel of Shavano trailhead is across the road. Bear country (bear closure order). --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed first-come only (fee tube / Scan and Pay), $25 (2026 rate table; two vehicles or one RV), vault toilet and hand-pump water. Added 14-night max, season mid-May to mid-September (no exact dates), the 50% Senior/Access discount the page states. Not stated: site count, lengths, hookups. Note: dropped the site-count/amenity/FCFS/Salida RD restatements.
flags: Criteria/fit: the FS page and rec.gov both say 'Parking for two vehicles or one small RV are allowed at each site; sites are better suited for tent camping' and 'ideally suited for tent camping'. No length is stated anywhere (rec.gov catalog is one placeholder site), so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits is not established - a human look is warranted.
Missing phone: the FS page gives the Salida Ranger District, 719-539-3591. rec.gov's 'facility specific information' line is (661) 702-1420 (the concessionaire's).

Website: the stored field is the FS campground page plus the forest's home page (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc); no trailing space in the stored value now, but the second URL is generic - the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/angel-shavano-campground (rec.gov: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165115).

Waterfront (stored riverfront): no per-site points exist (rec.gov has one placeholder at the facility point). On Esri imagery the loops sit south of CR 240 among conifers, the lowest spurs ~30-50 m from the North Fork through trees; the FS says sites are 'along the north fork'. An open apron at any site is not visible from above - riverfront is not confirmed, possibly riverview; a re-audit lead, not a change.

Pin 38.58447,-106.22043 is the FS/rec.gov facility point, on CR 240 at the head of the loop road (main entrance), ~80 m NW of the Angel of Shavano Group site point (38.58410,-106.21978); the loops lie 50-250 m south of it. Within tolerance.
Ownership: concessionaire-run campsites on Pike-San Isabel NF land; federal is right.

Access: CR 240 is gravel for the 3 miles to the campground; the FS calls Forest Road 240 BEYOND the campground (toward North Fork) a '4x4 road' - not this campground's access. No current PSICC alert found naming it.
